scope: All current source changes and untracked files against c224c2c; root triaged findings and verified final changes

findings.finding: Early clone validation could leave a pending entry
findings.evidence: Guard captures identity before opening and validation; actual clone+hardlink regression passes and fails on isolated earlier implementation.

findings.finding: Managed original errors used generated protocol codes
findings.evidence: OriginalMediaError maps missing/corrupt/cancelled/deadline cases; real missing/corrupt managed tests assert OriginalOffline/OriginalContentMismatch.

findings.finding: Same-user process can replace a clone before first identity observation
findings.evidence: fclonefileat does not atomically return a destination descriptor or inode. Cleanup only addresses its private pending name; same-user sandboxing is explicitly not claimed. Unidentifiable entries are retained.

findings.finding: Linked source could change on the same inode after hashing
findings.evidence: Final named/held metadata must equal the post-hash state; same-inode/same-length mutation regression passes and fails on the isolated old predicate.

findings.finding: FFmpeg probe can decode AAC despite discard
findings.evidence: All pinned FFmpeg probe decoder initialization paths propagate format codec_whitelist; avcodec_open2 rejects AAC before initialization. Actual fixture logs retain that rejection. AVDISCARD_ALL alone would not suffice.

findings.finding: Cleanup at the request deadline could surface EPERM instead of Deadline
findings.evidence: Bounded cleanup grace is separate from the request budget; deadline/cancellation is checked after cleanup before returning an IO failure.
